$comment: Read by the AI Orchestrator's Verify stage (.claude/scripts/verify.py) from the ORIGINAL branch, so a run can't weaken its own checks. Mirrors .github/workflows/ci.yml, plus the web tests and both builds that CI doesn't run. Steps run in order in a fresh worktree; database steps get a throwaway Postgres (Docker, or VERIFY_DATABASE_URL), never the real one.

steps.name: typecheck
steps.run: pnpm --filter @coin-collector/shared typecheck && pnpm --filter api typecheck && pnpm --filter web typecheck

steps.name: migrations apply to a fresh database
steps.run: pnpm --filter api exec prisma migrate deploy

steps.name: schema.prisma matches migrations
steps.run: cd apps/api && pnpm exec prisma migrate diff --from-url "$DATABASE_URL" --to-schema-datamodel prisma/schema.prisma --exit-code
steps.hint: schema.prisma has changes that no migration creates. Add a migration (prisma migrate dev --create-only) for them.

realDataCheck.$comment: Optional. When the branch adds migrations and NEON_API_KEY + NEON_PROJECT_ID are available (env or ~/.config/ai-orchestrator/neon.env), creates a temporary Neon branch (a copy of the real data), applies the migrations there, checks for drift, and deletes the branch.
